verdict.rationale: Close documents its own ways to get data out: pulling pipeline and reporting data into BI tools or a data warehouse via a REST API with a published OpenAPI spec (JSON), plus read-only MCP access. That gives a real but indirect exit path for structured data. However, nothing documents a dedicated full-account export, so getting all data out appears to require API scripting, and the event log covers only the last 30 days. missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-data export (e.g. CSV/JSON archive), explicit coverage of all object types including activities, recordings and attachments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export and offboarding.
